name: 90265 · Malibu, CA
findings: ZIP 90265 (Malibu) has 165 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90265 (Malibu) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90265 (Malibu) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
